logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of flavonoid ligands (HF1–HF3) and complexes 1–6 was evaluated by measuring their partition coefficients between n-octanol and water, employing a modified “shake flask” technique described in literature.[33] In brief, 5 mL solutions of the complexes at concentrations of 15, 20, and 25 µM were mixed with n-octanol-saturated water (OSW) by agitating them with 5 mL of water-saturated n-octanol (WSO) in a falcon tube for ∼30 min. The biphasic solution was subsequently centrifuged at ∼3000 rpm for 10 min to separate the two layers. The concentrations of 1–6 in the aqueous ([1–6]aq) and n-octanol ([1–6]oct) layers were measured using a UV–visible spectrophotometer by recording the absorbance of the complexes in the aqueous layer both before and after vortex mixing. The partition coefficients were calculated using the equation- logP = log{[1–6]oct/[1–6]aq}. logP values were expressed as the mean of three complex concentrations.
